title: A Study of a Digital Program for Helping Young Adult Cancer Survivors Learn About Financial Issues Related to Healthcare
official: Making Cents of Medical Costs: A Digital Financial Toxicity Intervention for Adolescent and Young Adult Cancer Survivors
summary: The purpose of this study is to find out whether the Making Cents of Medical Costs (MCMC) program is acceptable, appropriate, accessible, and practical (feasible) for young adult cancer survivors.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* English-speaking cancer survivors who are 18-39 years old
* Diagnosed with cancer after age 14
* Has access to an Internet-enabled device
* All disease sites and diagnosis are allowed; survivors must have completed active treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Received systemic therapy within the last 1 year
